perItemFindings.label: lem:non-gaussian-hard-submodel
perItemFindings.one_line: `productKL_tensorization_of_finite` requires one-sample `P₀ ≪ P₁` and `Integrable (llr P₀ P₁) P₀`; `gaussianReal_ac_gaussianReal` and `integrable_llr_gaussianReal` establish these only for each Gaussian outcome fibre, while `klDiv_compProd_right_of_forall_ac` gives a KL identity but not joint-llr integrability.

verbatim_critique: Re-plan the hard-submodel KL chain to explicitly discharge AC and llr-integrability for the full tilted one-observation laws before applying `productKL_tensorization_of_finite`. This needs a bounded compProd/bind transport proof (or a clean existing theorem), using the fibre Gaussian facts plus base integrability; do not claim the fibre lemmas supply the product theorem's joint hypotheses directly.
